CustomField.description:
6 or higher → DNQ (Does Not Qualify)
5 or lower → NYSITELL Eligible
Blank HLQ Result → Blank
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(HLQ_Result__c), "", IF( HLQ_Result__c >= 6, "DNQ", IF( HLQ_Result__c <= 5, "NYSITELL Eligible", "" ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText:
Determines ELL eligibility based on the student’s HLQ (Home Language Questionnaire) score:
6 or higher → DNQ (Does Not Qualify)
5 or lower → NYSITELL Eligible
Blank HLQ Result → Blank
CustomField.label: ELL Eligibility
